data.name: Description
data.value: Intercepts focus-loss messages of a game window so it keeps running in the background without pausing or muting. Windowed mode only; exclusive fullscreen is not supported.

data.name: WarningText
data.value: This feature injects a hook DLL into the target process and may be detected by some anti-cheat systems. Verify that the target game permits this kind of operation before use. The user assumes all responsibility for any consequences.

data.name: ElevationText
data.value: The host application is not running as administrator. If the target game is launched with admin privileges, injection will fail. Click the button below to restart the application as administrator.
